valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2026, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 24.87, price over EPS 35.11); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2026 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2026
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 7.22925e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_NGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2026, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 7.22925e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_NGX.json)
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: a compound growth rate of earnings is not defined from the periods on file: it needs net profit POSITIVE in BOTH endpoint years (FY2025 and FY2026), and one of them is not. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
